pageDescription: The Hands-off Hiring System: the four steps every Handoff hire goes through, from discovery to the guarantee.
body: A four-step process that keeps the sourcing and screening with us. You make one decision at the end: which finalist to place.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.body: We learn the role, the team it joins, and what a strong fit looks like to you. That profile sets the bar for the search.

steps.title: The Vet
steps.body: We start with roughly 200 candidates and screen down.
bullets: A skills assessment for the role
steps.after: Only the candidates who clear the full screen move forward.

steps.title: The Shortlist
steps.body: You see two. We bring you two candidates matched to the role, with their video, assessment results, and our notes. You interview both and choose.

steps.title: The Guarantee
steps.body: If your hire doesn't work out within 90 days, we replace them at no cost. We run the screening, so a miss is on us to fix.

closer.line: Every hire after your first gets easier. We learn your company, your culture, your bar for 'great.' By hire five, you might not meet the candidate until their first day.

pageCloser.headline: Start with the role
pageCloser.line: Tell us what you need to fill, and we'll open the search.

promo.label: Handoff: the team behind the hiring
